name: Hound Of Duat
title: Harrier of Souls
summary: Protect the guardians of the afterlife with powerful shields and protection buffs.
lore: Creations of Anubis, the Hounds of Duat aid in corralling lost souls and punishing those who violate the sanctity of tombs and graves. The alterations in magic since the Shattering have, however, driven a small portion of them feral. No longer paying heed to their creator or their assigned duties, they hunt for the pleasure of the kill, spreading death and chaos.
archetype_description: Reduce incoming damage by 1% for each piece of plate armor attuned

awakening_bonuses.description: Also, place [Phoenix] on this hero for 1 turn.
When an ally is defeated by an enemy, activate this ability and attack that enemy.

skills.name: Pack Tactics
skills.description:
Attack 1 enemy 95%DEF+85%ATK 2 times. Each hit has a 25% chance to steal 10% Divinity.

If Jackal or Anubis are allies, they each have a 50% chance to join the attack.

skills.name: Avert the Afterlife
skills.description:
Attack 1 enemy 245%DEF+215%ATK and place [Shield] on all allies for 25% of the damage inflicted.

If Jackal or Anubis are allies, has a 25% chance to refresh the cooldown of this ability when either of them are attacked.

awakening_bonuses.description: When an ally is defeated by an enemy, activate this ability and attack that enemy.
awakening_bonuses.upgrade_description: When an ally is defeated by an enemy, activate this ability and attack that enemy.

skills.name: Feeding Frenzy
skills.description: When attacking enemies, place [Barrier] on this hero for 10% of the damage inflicted.

skills.name: Grave Guardian
skills.description:
Place [Retaliate] on this hero for 1 turn and [Protect II] on all allies except this hero for 2 turns.

If Jackal or Anubis are allies, also place [Ward] on them for 1 turn.

awakening_bonuses.description: Also, place Phoenix on this hero for 1 turn.
